# Natural Design System

> Warm, quiet, material-first UI for **Natural**, an online store for nature-based goods that are both decorative and functional: a bench split from a fallen log, a cup thrown from river clay.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Figma** | [Natural Design System](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System) |
| **Storybook** | https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/ |
| **Code** | https://github.com/chris-terterian/natural-design-system |
| **Standard** | WCAG 2.2 AA |

**How to use this file.** It's the single brief for anyone designing or building for Natural, whether a person or Claude Code. The front matter lists every token with its resolved value, alias and CSS variable.

| § | Section | Answers |
|---|---|---|
| 1–2 | Brand, voice | How Natural looks and sounds |
| 3 | Foundations | The raw material: colour, type, space, radius, icons, imagery, motion |
| 4 | Styles | The named styles built from foundations: text, colour roles, effects, layout |
| 5 | Tokens | How tokens are structured and changed |
| 6 | Components | Full spec for every component: anatomy, properties, sizes, states, behaviour |
| 7 | Patterns | How components combine into store pages |
| 8–10 | Accessibility, workflow, roadmap | The non-negotiables and how changes ship |

Items marked **Planned** don't exist yet: don't invent them silently. Propose them. Values in this file are resolved from tokens. In code, always use the CSS variable (`--nds-*`), never the raw value.

---

## 1. Brand & principles

Natural sells things made from wood, clay, stone, fibre and other materials that come from the land. Each piece is useful and beautiful, and it carries the marks of how it was made: knots in the grain, ridges from the potter's hand, uneven edges. The interface is the display table, not the product.

1. **Let the material lead.** The UI is calm and low-contrast in structure so photography and material detail carry the page. No gradients, gloss, heavy shadows or decorative illustration competing with the product.
2. **Warm and tactile.** An earth palette (bark, clay, sand) with soft 8px corners and a single typeface. Surfaces feel like paper and linen, not glass.
3. **Honest.** Real materials, real dimensions, real weights, real lead times. If a piece is one of a kind or ships by freight, say so up front. No vague "eco" or "sustainable" claims without specifics.
4. **Made to last.** Like the goods: accessible, consistent and unhurried. Choose the durable pattern over the trendy one.
5. **Every piece is individual.** Handmade and natural items vary. The UI should make variation feel like a feature ("no two are alike"), never a defect.

---

## 2. Voice & content

**Craft-aware, grounded, quietly poetic.** We write like a maker talking about their work: specific about materials, process and time, with the occasional image from the natural world. Plain first, lyrical second.

### Voice rules

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Name the material, the process and the time it took. *"Cut from a single fallen oak and air-dried for two seasons."* | Use empty adjectives. *"Premium, high-quality, luxurious."* |
| Use one natural image, lightly. *"The glaze pools like still water at the base."* | Stack metaphors or go mystical. *"Channel the ancient spirit of the forest."* |
| Celebrate variation. *"Every knot and check in the grain is its own."* | Apologise for it. *"Slight imperfections may occur."* |
| Be specific about care. *"Oil twice a year to keep the wood from drying out."* | Make unprovable claims. *"100% eco-friendly and sustainable."* |
| Write in sentence case, in short sentences. | Use Title Case Everywhere, exclamation marks or ALL CAPS. |

**Clarity beats poetry.** Buttons, forms, errors, prices, shipping and legal text are always plain. The voice lives in product stories, collection intros and empty states, never in an error message.

### Product copy pattern

Every product page answers the same questions in the same order:

1. **Name:** material-led and simple. *Split Log Bench · River Clay Cup · Woven Rush Basket*
2. **One-line story:** where it came from and how it was made.
3. **Details:** material · finish · dimensions · weight · capacity (for vessels).
4. **Variation note:** why no two are the same.
5. **Care:** how to keep it for decades.
6. **Delivery:** lead time for made-to-order, and how large pieces ship.

> **River Clay Cup**
> Thrown by hand from clay dug near the river, then fired twice. The ash glaze pools where the wall meets the base, so no two cups carry the same colour.
> Stoneware · matte ash glaze · 9 cm tall · 300 ml · 280 g
> Dishwasher safe. Not for the microwave.

> **Split Log Bench**
> Split from a single fallen oak and air-dried for two seasons before shaping. Knots, checks and the grain's own colour are left as the tree grew them.
> Solid oak · natural oil finish · 120 × 35 × 45 cm · approx. 38 kg · seats two
> Oil twice a year. Ships by freight in 2–3 weeks.

### UI vocabulary (use these exact words)

| Context | Wording |
|---|---|
| Primary purchase | **Add to Bag** (never "cart") |
| Out of stock | **Sold out** + **Notify me** |
| Save for later | **Add to wishlist** / **Remove from wishlist** (accessible names) |
| Badges | **New** · **Handmade** · **One of a kind** · **Sale** · **Sold out** · **In stock** |
| Made to order | **Made to order · ships in {n} weeks** |
| Large items | **Ships by freight** |

### Empty states & microcopy

Empty states may carry the voice, briefly: *"Your bag is empty. The shop is quiet today, but something good is waiting."* Errors never do: *"Enter a valid email address."*

### Alt text

Describe what's shown, material first: *"River clay cup with a matte grey ash glaze pooling at the base, held in one hand."* Don't start with "Image of". Decorative background textures get `alt=""`.

**Contrast (all measured, WCAG 2.x formula):**

| Foreground | Background | Ratio | Passes |
|---|---|---|---|
| brown/900 | white | 13.67 | AA text |
| brown/900 | brown/50 | 11.99 | AA text |
| brown/900 | brown/100 | 11.08 | AA text |
| brown/900 | brown/200 | 7.73 | AA text |

| brown/800 | white | 7.51 | AA text |
| brown/600 | white | 4.95 | AA text, UI boundary |
| red/600 | white | 6.54 | AA text |
| green/600 | white | 6.38 | AA text |
| white | brown/900 · red/600 · green/600 | 13.67 · 6.54 · 6.38 | AA text |
| taupe/500 | white · brown/100 | 3.29 · 2.66 | Disabled only (WCAG-exempt) |
| taupe/400 | white | 2.45 | Disabled only (WCAG-exempt) |
| taupe/200 | white | 1.40 | Decorative dividers only |

**Rules:** Text is brown/900 or brown/800 on light surfaces, never a lighter brown. Never put brown/600 or lighter text on brown/200 or darker fills. Red and green always travel with an icon or words; colour is never the only signal.

### 3.6 Imagery

Photography is the product's voice.

- **Crop:** 4:5 portrait in cards (280 × 350); the backdrop is brown/100 while images load.
- **Light:** natural daylight, soft shadows, true-to-life colour. Never oversaturated.
- **Backdrop:** neutral linen, plaster or wood tones close to brown/50–brown/150.
- **Show three things per product:** the whole piece, a material close-up (grain, glaze, weave) and scale or use (a person on the bench, a hand around the cup).
- **Sold out:** image at 60% opacity on a brown/50 backdrop.

**Planned:** a real photography set (the Figma Images page is empty; cards use `Image/Placeholder`).

### 3.7 Motion

Quiet and brief. Colour and border changes: 120ms ease. Product image hover zoom: `scale(1.05)` over 300ms ease. Loading spinner: one rotation every 800ms, linear. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the zoom is removed and the spinner slows to 2400ms (it stays, because it's the only sign of progress). Nothing else bounces, slides in, or loops.

## 5. Tokens

Two layers, identical in Figma and code:

1. **Primitives** (`color/brown/200`, `space/12`, …): raw values. Hidden from Figma's pickers; never used directly in components.
2. **Component tokens** (`button/primary/bg/default`, `input/border/error`, …): aliases of primitives, in collections Button, Input, Radio, Product Card, Badge, Navigation.

Naming: `component/part/property/state`. The Figma name `button/primary/bg/default` becomes the CSS variable `--nds-button-primary-bg-default: var(--nds-color-brown-200)`.

**To add or change a token:**
1. Edit `tokens/figma-variables.json` (Figma names; no `.` in names, so use `1-5`, not `1.5`).
2. Run `npm run tokens`, which regenerates `src/styles/tokens.css` and this file's front matter.
3. Push to Figma: run the output of `npm run figma:sync-script` in the file. It creates and updates variables but never deletes; remove variables by hand after checking nothing uses them.
4. Confirm Figma and JSON match (same variable count and values).

---

## 6. Components

Every component exists in Figma and code with the same name, variants and states. Each has a Storybook **All Variants** story laid out like its Figma grid (State columns, variant rows) with a link to its Figma node. States called `forceState` in code exist only so docs can show hover, pressed and focus without interaction; real interaction uses CSS `:hover`, `:active` and `:focus-visible`.

Import everything from the package root:

```tsx
import { Button, Badge, TextField, TextArea, Radio, RadioGroup, WishlistButton, ProductCard,
  NavigationMenu, MobileMenu, NavLink, IconButton, MenuItem, Logo } from 'natural-design-system';
import 'natural-design-system/styles.css';
```

### 6.1 Logo

[Figma 59:67](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=59-67) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-navigation-menu--logo-story)

**Purpose:** the Natural wordmark, linking home. **Anatomy:** ① Wordmark "natural".

| Figma property | Type | Default | Code prop | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | | | `href` | `'/'` (plus native anchor attributes) |

**Style:** Logo text style (§4.1), colour `nav/logo` (13.67:1). **States:** focus ring (2px, 2px gap, radius 8).
**Accessibility:** rendered as a link with `aria-label="Natural — home"`.
**Rule:** the same wordmark on every breakpoint; never add a tagline or descriptor beside it.

### 6.2 Button

[Figma 1:202](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=1-202) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-button--all-variants)

**Purpose:** actions. **Primary** (sand fill) for the one main action per view (Add to Bag); **Secondary** (white, outlined) for everything else (Notify me, Cancel).
**Anatomy:** ① Container · ② Left icon (optional) · ③ Label · ④ Right icon (optional) · ⑤ Spinner (Loading) · ⑥ Focus ring.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Style | Variant | Primary, Secondary | `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary'` = `'primary'` |
| Icon | Variant | None, Left, Right, Both | `leftIcon`, `rightIcon` | `ReactNode` |
| State | Variant | Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled, Loading | `disabled`, `loading`, `forceState` | `boolean`; `boolean`; `'hover' \| 'pressed' \| 'focus'` |
| Label | Text | "Button" | `children` | `ReactNode` (required) |
| Left icon | Instance swap | Icon/Plus | `leftIcon` | |
| Right icon | Instance swap | Icon/Arrow Right | `rightIcon` | |
| Full width | instance sizing | set the instance to **Fill container** | `fullWidth` | `boolean` = `false` |
| none | | | `type` | `'button'` (plus all native button attributes) |

| Layout | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Min height | `button/min-height` | 44px |
| Padding | `button/padding-y` · `button/padding-x` | 12 · 24px |
| Padding on an icon side | `button/padding-x-icon` | 20px |
| Icon–label gap | `button/gap` | 8px |
| Radius | `button/radius` | 8px |
| Border | `button/border-width` | 1px |
| Text | Button style | 16 / 20, 600 |
| Icon · spinner | `button/icon-size` | 20px |

| State | Primary bg / text / border | Secondary bg / text / border |
|---|---|---|
| Default | `#D8BFA0` / `#3B2A1E` / `#8A6A4A` (7.73:1) | `#FFFFFF` / `#3B2A1E` / `#8A6A4A` (13.67:1) |
| Hover | `#CBAE8A` / `#3B2A1E` / `#7A5C3E` (6.49:1) | `#F6EFE7` / `#3B2A1E` / `#6B4F35` (11.99:1) |
| Pressed | `#BC9D76` / `#3B2A1E` / `#7A5C3E` (5.35:1) | `#EADCCB` / `#3B2A1E` / `#6B4F35` (10.16:1) |
| Focus | Default + focus ring (2px `#3B2A1E`, 2px gap, radius 12) | same |
| Disabled | `#EFE6DB` / `#9C8B7A` / `#DCCFBF` (exempt) | `#FFFFFF` / `#B3A392` / `#E3D8CB` (exempt) |
| Loading | Default colours; label and icons invisible (width kept); Spinner centred in `button/spinner` `#3B2A1E` | same |

**Behaviour & accessibility:** native `<button>`; `type="button"` by default. Icons are decorative (`aria-hidden`); the label names the action. **Loading** sets `aria-busy="true"` and `aria-disabled="true"` and ignores clicks; the label is hidden with `opacity: 0` (never `visibility: hidden`) so the button keeps its accessible name. Use it after the click (e.g. while adding to the bag), not as a default state. **Full width** is for narrow containers: product cards, mobile sheets, forms.
**Do:** one Primary per area; verb-first labels ("Add to Bag"). **Don't:** use a Button to navigate (use a link), place two Primaries side by side, or make an icon-only Button (use Icon Button).

### 6.3 Badge

[Figma 2:171](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=2-171) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-badge--all-variants)

**Purpose:** short status labels on products; counts on the Bag icon. **Anatomy:** ① Pill container · ② Label.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tone | Variant | Dark, Light, Sale, Success, Outline | `tone` | `'dark' \| 'light' \| 'sale' \| 'success' \| 'outline'` = `'dark'` |
| Label | Text | "Badge" | `children` | `ReactNode` |

| Layout | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Padding | `badge/padding-y` · `badge/padding-x` | 2 · 8px |
| Radius | `badge/radius` | full |
| Border (inset) | `badge/border-width` | 1px |
| Text | Badge style | 12 / 16, 600 |

| Tone | Background | Text | Border | Contrast | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dark | `#3B2A1E` | `#FFFFFF` | `#3B2A1E` | 13.67 | New, bag count |
| Light | `#EFE6DB` | `#3B2A1E` | `#EFE6DB` | 11.08 | Handmade, One of a kind |
| Sale | `#B3261E` | `#FFFFFF` | `#B3261E` | 6.54 | Sale |
| Success | `#2E6B3F` | `#FFFFFF` | `#2E6B3F` | 6.38 | In stock |
| Outline | `#FFFFFF` | `#3B2A1E` | `#8A6A4A` | 13.67 | Sold out |

**Rules:** one or two words; the words carry the meaning, tone only reinforces it. Not interactive. Use at most one badge per product card.

### 6.4 Text Field

[Figma 1:498](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=1-498) (Type=Text) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-input--all-variants)

**Purpose:** single-line text entry. **Anatomy:** ① Label · ② Field container · ③ Value / placeholder · ④ Status icon (error/success) · ⑤ Helper row (icon + message) · ⑥ Focus ring.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Type | Variant | Text, Textarea | component | `TextField` / `TextArea` |
| State | Variant | Default, Hover, Focus, Filled, Error, Success, Disabled, Read-only | `status`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `forceState` | `'default' \| 'error' \| 'success'`; `'hover' \| 'focus'` |
| Label | Text | "Label" | `label` | `string` (required) |
| Show label | Boolean | true | `hideLabel` | `boolean` = `false` (label stays for screen readers) |
| Show helper | Boolean | true | `helperText` | `ReactNode` (omit to hide) |
| none | | | `statusMessage` | `ReactNode`: replaces helper text in error/success |
| none | | | native input attributes | `placeholder`, `defaultValue`, `id`, `type`… |

| Layout | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Width | `input/width` | 320px |
| Field min height | `input/min-height` | 44px |
| Field padding | `input/padding-y` · `input/padding-x` | 10 · 12px |
| Field inner gap | `input/field-gap` | 8px |
| Label→field, field→helper, icon→message | `input/gap` | 6px |
| Radius · border | `input/radius` · `input/border-width` | 8px · 1px |
| Text | Label; Body (value); Small (helper) | |

| State | Field bg | Border | Value text | Helper |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Default | `#FFFFFF` | `#8A6A4A` | placeholder `#8A6A4A` (4.95) | `#6B4F35` |
| Hover | `#FFFFFF` | `#6B4F35` | placeholder | `#6B4F35` |
| Focus | `#FFFFFF` | `#3B2A1E` + focus ring | placeholder | `#6B4F35` |
| Filled | `#FFFFFF` | `#8A6A4A` | `#3B2A1E` (13.67) | `#6B4F35` |
| Error | `#FFFFFF` | `#B3261E` | `#3B2A1E` + Alert icon | `#B3261E` + Alert icon |
| Success | `#FFFFFF` | `#2E6B3F` | `#3B2A1E` + Check icon | `#2E6B3F` + Check icon |
| Disabled | `#EFE6DB` | `#DCCFBF` | `#9C8B7A` (exempt) | `#9C8B7A` (label too) |
| Read-only | `#F6EFE7` | `#8A6A4A` | `#3B2A1E` | `#6B4F35` |

**Behaviour & accessibility:** `<label for>` always present; message linked with `aria-describedby`; error sets `aria-invalid`. Value text is 16px so iOS doesn't zoom.
**Do:** say how to fix an error ("Enter a valid email address."). **Don't:** use placeholder as the label, or show error colour without the message.

### 6.7 Radio Group

Code only (`RadioGroup`); shown in Figma as the "Shipping method" and "Ring size" examples on the Radio Buttons page. [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-radio--shipping-method)

| Code prop | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `legend` | `ReactNode` (required) | Rendered as `<legend>`, Label style |
| `value`, `onChange` | `string`, `(value) => void` | Controlled selection |
| `name` | `string` | Auto-generated if omitted |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | Group error: Alert icon + message in Critical, marks every radio invalid |
| `children` | `Radio` elements | 12px apart; legend 12px above |

**Rules:** always use a group with a legend; show errors once at group level, never per option.

[Figma 1:968](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=1-968) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-product-card--all-variants)

| Price | Text | "$120" | `price` | `string` (required) |
| Compare price | Text | "$150" | `comparePrice` | `string` (shown when sale) |
| Show badge | Boolean | true | `badge` | `string \| false`; default by status: New / Sale / Sold out |
| Badge (nested, exposed) | Tone + Label | Dark·New / Sale·Sale / Outline·Sold out | `badgeTone` | `BadgeTone`; default by status |
| Show wishlist | Boolean | true | `showWishlist`, `wishlisted`, `onWishlistChange` | `true`; `boolean`; handler |
| Show CTA | Boolean | true | `showCta`, `onAddToCart`, `onNotify` | `true`; handlers |
| Image | Instance swap | Image/Placeholder | `imageSrc`, `imageAlt` | `string`; `''` |
| none | | | `href` | `string` (required), the title link |

| Layout | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Width · media height | `card/width` · `card/media-height` | 280 · 350px |
| Media radius | `card/radius` | 8px |
| Badge / wishlist inset | `card/media-inset` | 12px |
| Media→info, info→CTA gap | `card/gap` | 12px |
| Info line gap | `card/info-gap` | 4px |
| Price gap | `card/price-gap` | 8px |
| Text | Body Strong (title, price), Small (meta, compare price) | |

| Status | Badge | Price | Media | CTA |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Default | Dark "New" | `#3B2A1E` | `#EFE6DB` backdrop | Primary "Add to Bag" |
| Sale | Sale "Sale" | Sale `#B3261E` (6.54) + struck `#8A6A4A` (4.95) | `#EFE6DB` | Primary "Add to Bag" |
| Sold out | Outline "Sold out" | `#3B2A1E` | `#F6EFE7`, image 60% | Secondary "Notify me" |

| State | Change |
|---|---|
| Hover | Image zoom 5%, title underlined |
| Focus | 2px Ink ring around the whole card, 4px gap (title link has keyboard focus) |

**Behaviour & accessibility:** the whole card is clickable through the title link (stretched link); the wishlist and CTA sit above it as separate focus stops. The sale price is announced as "Sale price … Original price …".
**Rules:** meta is material first (*"Stoneware · ash glaze"*). One badge maximum. Never hide the price.

**Behaviour & accessibility:** native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`; focus moves inside and is trapped; Escape or Close closes it and returns focus to the Menu button; the backdrop uses Backdrop / Modal. Size in Figma 375 × 812.

### 6.15 Image Placeholder

### 6.16 Spinner

[Figma 64:50](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=64-50) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-spinner--default)

**Purpose:** an indeterminate loading indicator, used inside Button's Loading state. **Anatomy:** ① Track (full circle, 25% opacity) · ② Arc (quarter circle, round cap).

| Property | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Size | `button/icon-size` | 20px |
| Stroke | none | 2px |
| Colour | `button/spinner` | `#3B2A1E` |
| Motion | Spin / Loading (§4.3) | 800ms per turn; 2400ms under reduced motion |

**Accessibility:** decorative (`aria-hidden`). The control that owns it must announce the busy state (`aria-busy`) or show text.

## 8. Accessibility standard (WCAG 2.2 AA)

Non-negotiable for every component and page:

- **Contrast:** text ≥ 4.5:1; UI boundaries, icons and focus rings ≥ 3:1. Disabled controls are exempt and intentionally faded.
- **Never colour alone:** errors pair an icon with a message, sale pairs a badge with a strikethrough, the current page pairs an indicator with a heavier weight, and wishlist state pairs a filled shape.
- **Targets:** 44px minimum for controls, never below 24px.
- **Focus:** always visible, using the Focus ring style (§4.3).
- **Semantics:** real buttons for actions, links for navigation, `fieldset`/`legend` for groups, `aria-pressed` for toggles, `aria-current` for the current page, `<dialog>` for the mobile menu.
- **Names:** every icon-only control has an accessible name that includes context (*"Add River Clay Cup to wishlist"*, *"Bag, 2 items"*).
- **Motion:** respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Check:** run the Storybook Accessibility panel (axe) on every story before shipping.

## 9. Workflow

**The repo is the source of truth.** Figma mirrors it; Storybook shows it.

1. Change tokens or components in code (or design in Figma, then mirror to code).
2. Check it in Storybook (`npm run storybook` → http://localhost:6007): All Variants story plus the axe panel.
3. Update Figma: sync variables (§5) and apply component changes, then screenshot to verify.
4. Confirm Figma and code match: same component names, variants, properties and token values. Update §6 of this file.
5. **Ask before committing and pushing** to `main`. A push deploys Storybook to GitHub Pages in about 2 minutes.

**Adding a component checklist**
- [ ] Figma: component set with labelled grid (State columns, variant rows), every fill, stroke, size and type bound to variables, contrast noted.
- [ ] Reuse, don't rebuild: nest existing components (Button, Badge, Icon Button…) as exposed instances.
- [ ] Tokens: a component collection aliasing primitives, mirrored in `tokens/figma-variables.json`.
- [ ] Code: `src/components/<Name>/` with `.tsx`, `.css` (tokens only) and `.stories.tsx` (Figma link + All Variants).
- [ ] Export from `src/index.ts`; add a full spec to §6 (same template) and a row to the README table.
- [ ] Typecheck, build, axe clean; Figma and JSON match.
